usedFor: Avaza handles your projects and billing, and Slack tells the team when “Invoice Sent” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Invoice Sent” in Avaza, then “Send Message” in Slack

watchOut: An automation's “Send Message” post to a Slack channel waits for your approval today, so expect a tap first.
